svg.title: Dot peen and laser DataMatrix direct part marking
svg.text: Direct part marking (DPM) – dot peen vs. fibre laser DataMatrix on the crankcase, cell size and grading
Symbol: plain serial VC20-2546-00123 = 10 codewords → 16 × 16 ECC 200. Values are typical – confirm with marking trials on real castings.
B FIBRE LASER (1064 nm, 20–50 W, engrave / anneal)
• needs a flat pad (milled, Ra ≤ 6.3 µm)
cone 90°–120°, depth 0.1–0.3 mm, pitch = cell size
engraved cell 20–100 µm deep, flat bottom; or annealed (no depth)
Grading – ISO/IEC TR 29158 (AIM DPM) for DPM, ISO/IEC 15415 for printed 2D codes; grade 4/A … 0/F, overall = lowest parameter
Typical cause of a low grade
symbol decodes with the reference algorithm
dots too shallow, shiny surface, wrong light
uniformity of dark and light cells
finder L and clock track intact
mark over an edge, chips, paint
cells on a regular square grid
dots overlap or are too small
Project acceptance (example): ≥ B (3.0) on the verifier at marking; ≥ C (2.0) with the production reader after machining + washing. Check one part per shift.
